Trump claims Iran accepted terms, suggesting de-escalation

US President Donald Trump has claimed that Iran has accepted "almost all" of his terms, suggesting a potential de-escalation of tensions. This statement comes amid ongoing discussions between the two nations. The specifics of the terms and Iran's official response remain unclear, but Trump's assertion implies a significant development in their relationship.
